comment: The pinned, reduced AOSP tree the patched SurfaceFlinger, libhwui and libEGL are built from (the Framework build workflow), one entry per Android version DSA ships an image of. Every commit is the one the published build named by build_id was made from (its manifest_<build_id>.xml, which the workflow checks), so the files the image takes are built from the exact source of the build the image is made from. release, clang and rust are that build's own (its build_flags.json and build/soong). A project may be fetched in part, as in dsa/guest/arm-translation/digitalis-lock.json. framework_lock.py reads and checks it; update-lock.py moves it to another build.
